ui.ending.title: The End of 24 Weeks
ui.ending.subtitle: Lumen remembers the direction Noa chose.
ui.event.legacy: A legacy record has opened a new choice.

legacy.stargazer.title: Legacy of the Stargazer
legacy.gardener.title: Legacy of the Gardener
legacy.pathfinder.title: Legacy of the Pathfinder
personality.quiet.name: Quiet Observer
personality.kind.name: Kind Connector
personality.bold.name: Brave Pathfinder
personality.bold.voice: They move first, even after a mistake.
personality.quiet.line: Stars do not hurry. Today, I will look slowly too.
personality.kind.line: When you smile, even the garden seems a little brighter.
personality.bold.line: If there is no road, we can make one with today's step!
event.mail.title: The Dawn Mailbox
event.mail.body: Before sunrise, a letter from nowhere arrived. Who should read it first?
event.mail.lumi.label: Ask Lumi for the star's name
event.mail.lumi.line: Naming the unknown brings it a little closer.
event.mail.bora.label: Share the news on the village board
event.mail.bora.line: Good news lasts longer when it is shared.
event.rain.title: The Night of Rain
event.rain.body: The village lamps went dark. Whose hand will Noa reach for first?
event.rain.bora.label: Share lantern light with the children
event.rain.bora.line: Even a small light becomes a path when shared.
event.rain.lumi.label: Read the stars and find the way
event.rain.lumi.line: The sky has not hidden its direction yet.
event.bridge.title: How to Cross the River
event.bridge.body: The old bridge trembles. With what heart will we cross today?
event.bridge.taro.label: Take the first step
event.bridge.taro.line: Even if I tremble, this step is mine.
event.bridge.bora.label: Match everyone's pace
event.bridge.bora.line: A river feels less frightening at one shared pace.
event.windmill.title: The Afternoon the Wind Stopped
event.windmill.body: The windmill stopped and the greenhouse window would not close. Who will help?
event.windmill.taro.label: Repair the windmill with Taro
event.windmill.taro.line: Even still wind can move again when hands reach it.
event.windmill.bora.label: Listen to Bora and Taro together
event.windmill.bora.line: When we hear each other's wind, we can build the road again.
event.letter.title: A Letter on the Wind
event.letter.body: A distant province asks for help. What answer will Noa send?
event.letter.lumi.label: Record a careful reply
event.letter.lumi.line: Precise words can become a road across distance.
event.letter.taro.label: Promise to go there in person
event.letter.taro.line: I will not make you wait. I will go.
event.festival.title: The Eve of the Festival
event.festival.body: One last preparation remains. What will Noa care for first?
event.festival.bora.label: Make a place for everyone to rest
event.festival.bora.line: A joyful day still needs a place to rest.
event.festival.taro.label: Build a new stage by hand
event.festival.taro.line: It may lean a little, but we will build it ourselves.
event.greenhouse.title: A Small Crack in the Greenhouse
event.greenhouse.body: A small crack appeared in the greenhouse roof. Whose way will protect spring?
event.greenhouse.lumi.label: Ask Lumi about the starlight angle
event.greenhouse.lumi.line: If we know where light rests, even a crack can become a path.
event.greenhouse.bora.label: Patch it with Bora
event.greenhouse.bora.line: A place we mend together will hold for a long time.
event.outing.market.title: A Walk Through the Moonlit Market
event.outing.market.body: A short holiday opens up. Who will Noa meet beyond Lumen after spending a few coins?
event.outing.market.lumi.label: Find an old map with Lumi
event.outing.market.lumi.line: Even a map's edge holds a clue to the next road.
event.outing.market.bora.label: Browse the seed stalls with Bora
event.outing.market.bora.line: If we choose the same seeds, tomorrow's garden may grow alike.
event.outing.hill.title: A Promise on the Wind Hill
event.outing.hill.body: The last holiday before the ending arrives. Whose walking time will shape the next season?
event.outing.hill.taro.label: Walk the unnamed road with Taro
event.outing.hill.taro.line: It is not too late to name a road after we walk it.
event.outing.hill.lumi.label: Leave a starlight marker with Lumi
event.outing.hill.lumi.line: A marker home means we can go far without losing the way.
event.bell.title: A Bell Beyond the Map
event.bell.body: Every evening, a bell rings beyond the map. Where will Noa listen?
event.bell.lumi.label: Record the bell's intervals with Lumi
event.bell.lumi.line: Record the intervals, and an unseen road may appear.
event.bell.taro.label: Find the bell with Taro
event.bell.taro.line: Let's walk all the way to where we hear it!
event.firstLedger.title: The First Ledger Night
event.firstLedger.body: The first twelve weeks are bound into one ledger. Will Noa keep only the numbers, or the voices that made them?
event.firstLedger.lumi.label: Record the order of evidence with Lumi
event.firstLedger.lumi.line: Do not record only the result; record the footsteps that reached it.
event.firstLedger.bora.label: Leave everyone's voice in the ledger with Bora
event.firstLedger.bora.line: When names enter the record, no one has to carry the decision alone.
event.frostWindow.title: The Greenhouse Beneath Frost
event.frostWindow.body: Overnight frost turns the greenhouse glass white. The seeds inside teach that waiting can come before light.
event.frostWindow.bora.label: Protect the seeds by lowering the heat with Bora
event.frostWindow.bora.line: Care sometimes needs the courage not to force growth.
event.frostWindow.taro.label: Repair the ice frame with Taro
event.frostWindow.taro.line: A stopped mechanism can move again when we inspect it piece by piece.
event.winterMarket.title: The Empty Chair at the Winter Market
event.winterMarket.body: An empty chair stands in the middle of the market. No one knows whether it waits for someone who left or someone who will arrive.
event.winterMarket.taro.label: Look for the chair's owner with Taro
event.winterMarket.taro.line: Do not fear an empty place; ask who it belongs to.
event.winterMarket.lumi.label: Record the time of waiting with Lumi
event.winterMarket.lumi.line: Waiting is also a map that lets someone return.
event.seedVault.title: The Seed Vault Door
event.seedVault.body: No seal marks the door to the storehouse across the river. Before opening it, Noa must find a reason everyone can share.
event.seedVault.lumi.label: Write public conditions with Lumi
event.seedVault.lumi.line: Before a key, let us make conditions anyone can check.
event.seedVault.bora.label: Share the vault's seeds with Bora
event.seedVault.bora.line: When the rule for sharing is shared, the seeds belong to no single person.
event.returningWater.title: The Back of the Returned Letter
event.returningWater.body: A reply arrives from the distant province. Behind its thanks is news that Lumen's choice reached more people than expected.
event.returningWater.bora.label: List the help we received with Bora
event.returningWater.bora.line: Remembering who helped us makes the next help fairer.
event.returningWater.taro.label: Walk the letter's road with Taro
event.returningWater.taro.line: If a letter arrived, we can walk that road again.
event.sharedRepair.title: A Door Lifted by Two Hands
event.sharedRepair.body: The new greenhouse door is too heavy for one person. Can people who repaired it differently hold the same handle?
event.sharedRepair.taro.label: Align the hinges again with Taro
event.sharedRepair.taro.line: Remove the wrong screw and align it again.
event.sharedRepair.lumi.label: Record the difference between designs with Lumi
event.sharedRepair.lumi.line: A different design can be evidence for the next choice, not an error.
event.riverCouncil.title: The Shared Well Promise
event.riverCouncil.body: The market argues over who should receive the shared well's water first. The rule-maker and the person drawing water both need a voice.
event.riverCouncil.lumi.label: Publish the distribution order with Lumi
event.riverCouncil.lumi.line: When everyone can see the order, waiting becomes a promise.
event.riverCouncil.bora.label: Check the most thirsty homes with Bora
event.riverCouncil.bora.line: A shared rule must still see who is thirsty now.
event.openRecord.title: The Open Record Day
event.openRecord.body: The first ledger is shown to everyone. Each reader finds a different blank, and Noa must choose whether to hide it or leave it as a question.
event.openRecord.bora.label: Hold a meeting to fill the blanks with Bora
event.openRecord.bora.line: A record stays alive when people can say what they do not know together.
event.openRecord.taro.label: Publish a map that marks every blank with Taro
event.openRecord.taro.line: When everyone sees the blank, no one has to find the next road alone.
event.threeMaps.title: Three Maps
event.threeMaps.body: Lumi's star map, Bora's seed map, and Taro's wind map lie on one table. The lines that disagree must be read together instead of erased.
event.threeMaps.taro.label: Check the road markers with Taro
event.threeMaps.taro.line: A map becomes a road when it meets the stones underfoot.
event.threeMaps.lumi.label: Find common lines with Lumi
event.threeMaps.lumi.line: Where different lines meet, there is a reason to verify together.
event.disagreement.title: The Night of Different Constellations
event.disagreement.body: Three judgments split inside the ledger once believed complete. Instead of choosing whose answer is right, Noa studies where each answer began.
event.disagreement.lumi.label: Place the evidence side by side with Lumi
event.disagreement.lumi.line: Before an answer, let us check whether we are looking at the same star.
event.disagreement.bora.label: Test the smallest agreement with Bora
event.disagreement.bora.line: A large promise grows when small agreements continue safely.
event.horizonMarket.title: The Horizon Market
event.horizonMarket.body: A market opens at Lumen's edge to launch a new route. Those who leave and those who stay must be able to read the same price tag.
event.horizonMarket.bora.label: Make a safe place for those who stay with Bora
event.horizonMarket.bora.line: Leaving is possible only when the place left behind is safe.
event.horizonMarket.taro.label: Raise the first marker of the new route with Taro
event.horizonMarket.taro.line: A first marker is a promise that the road can be found again, not a destination.
event.lastMarker.title: The Last Marker
event.lastMarker.body: On the last night before the ending, only one marker can remain on the wind road. Noa chooses a rule the next person can check over a name of their own.
event.lastMarker.taro.label: Raise a marker anyone can see with Taro
event.lastMarker.taro.line: The road must be findable even when I am gone.
event.lastMarker.lumi.label: Leave the last evidence as a constellation with Lumi
event.lastMarker.lumi.line: A final record is not closure; it is the start of the next verification.
companion.lumi.greeting: A record helps the heart find its way again.
companion.lumi.epilogue: Lumi left a tiny star beside the first page of Noa's record.
companion.bora.greeting: Time we grow together does not wither easily.
companion.bora.epilogue: Bora and Noa planted new seeds at the turning of every season.
companion.taro.greeting: Even a broken road can join again when we reach for it!
companion.taro.epilogue: Taro took Noa down a road that still had no name on any map.
ending.stargazer.title: Lumen's Stargazer
ending.stargazer.body: Noa read the grain of the night sky and lit the province's routes.
ending.stargazer-master.title: Navigator Who Counts the Dawn
ending.stargazer-master.body: Noa recorded the cycles of stars and wind for 24 weeks, leaving a map whose judgments everyone could verify.
ending.gardener.title: Gardener of Hearts
ending.gardener.body: Noa made a garden where different hearts could bloom together.
ending.gardener-master.title: Keeper of the Village Warmth
ending.gardener-master.body: Noa opened a square where stories could meet before quarrels began and every judgment's evidence could be read together.
ending.pathfinder.title: Pathfinder of New Roads
ending.pathfinder.body: Noa left the first footprint on a road without a name.
ending.pathfinder-master.title: Vanguard Beyond the Border
ending.pathfinder-master.body: Noa showed that one can move forward without erasing fear, leaving markers that let the next person replay the road.
chapter.arrival.title: The Starseed Arrives
chapter.arrival.premise: A strange record and a first letter disturb Lumen's quiet.
chapter.arrival.payoff: Noa decides whose voice to trust first.
chapter.crossing.title: The Trembling Bridge
chapter.crossing.premise: A growing heart learns that crossing together matters more than being first.
chapter.crossing.payoff: Noa chooses today's balance between speed and courage.
chapter.reply.title: A Reply from Afar
chapter.reply.premise: A request beyond Lumen calls Noa away from a safe routine.
chapter.reply.payoff: Noa accepts the cost of recording the truth or leaving to meet it.
chapter.threshold.title: At Winter's Threshold
chapter.threshold.premise: Under festival lights, past choices gather into one direction.
chapter.threshold.payoff: Noa opens a door toward a chosen tomorrow, not a throne.
chapter.frost.title: The Seed Beneath Frost
chapter.frost.premise: After the first ledger, unfinished promises still sleep beneath Lumen's ground.
chapter.frost.payoff: Noa decides whether to call stillness failure or prepare the next bloom.
chapter.return.title: The Returning Waterway
chapter.return.premise: A distant reply returns, and Noa's choices are written on the faces of Lumen's people.
chapter.return.payoff: Noa learns to receive help and return it in the same motion.
chapter.constellation.title: Different Constellations
chapter.constellation.premise: On a night of clashing directions, even the shared map gains a blank space.
chapter.constellation.payoff: Noa chooses whether to own the answer or return its evidence to everyone.
chapter.horizon.title: The Unnamed Horizon
chapter.horizon.premise: The last horizon asks not who was right, but which rule will remain.
chapter.horizon.payoff: Noa leaves a road that the next person can verify instead of leaving only an answer.
